subject: fix(xpu): stabilize Qwen GDN prefill and mixed scheduling
requirement: On XPU, for Qwen GDN text-only, non-speculative, cache-mode=none, keep non-final prefills on the absolute 64-token arithmetic grid even when mixed-batch scheduling reduces the available token budget. Preserve final tails and progress. Existing cache/checkpoint alignment in other modes stays in force.

For ordinary mixed native SYCL batches, process contiguous cached one-token decodes with decode arithmetic ahead of prefill work. Otherwise a peer prefill changes recurrent arithmetic, output and subsequent state. The Qwen-specific grid excludes the deployed multimodal V2/DFlash2 configuration. Mixed dispatch is guarded by the actual batch metadata.

upstream_coverage.finding: The exact target GDNAttentionMetadataBuilder can reuse metadata on XPU. Its ordinary branch computes decode/prefill counts and removes trailing padding. It does not split the fused SYCL dispatch. Preserve metadata reuse and all four counts. Target QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention.forward_xpu still calls torch.ops.vllm.gdn_attention_core_xpu on the SYCL path at qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py:1461. Both upstream bases have identical vllm/_xpu_ops.py blob 166534e5b1a78c28fe4820005835959758bae20c.

Adaptive verification permits CPU/device length differences and makes uniform-spec assumptions conditional. This code handles speculative batches. Keep the fork keyword false on speculative, indexed, masked, multi-token decode and incomplete counts; no change to adaptive verification.

After runner V1 removal the V2 scheduler still enables _mamba_block_aligned_split only for mamba_cache_mode=='align' (scheduler.py:442); it rounds using cache block size. Running and waiting admissions call it conditionally at 876 and 1400. XPUPlatform special-cases the generic GDN name at xpu.py:494 for cache block size, which cannot constrain mode=none scheduler chunks. FLA_CHUNK_SIZE remains 64. Target vllm contains neither QWEN_GDN_ATTN nor get_required_prefill_chunk_size.

derive_mamba_conv_split now handles dim-first and state-first conv layouts, shared with Mooncake. Its allowed enum set and the GDN Q/K/V decomposition still recognize GDN_ATTN alone. Add the new XPU-specific Qwen identity to both sites, preserving upstream layout/TP logic.

torch_bindings.cpp:277 schema ends in bool reorder_input, with no mixed split switch. Xe2 chunk_gated_delta_rule_kernels_xe2.hpp:1530 and gated_delta_rule.hpp:704 choose decode-only arithmetic for num_prefills==0 && num_decodes>0. Classifying and counting mixed tokens alone does not give them this arithmetic.

minimal_residual: Retain Qwen's XPU-only GDN class/enum, backend arithmetic-chunk hook, XPU platform/transfer aliases, scheduler alignment split and starvation guards. Preserve upstream hashing, checkpoint, multimodal and resumed-request paths. Non-XPU layers keep the inherited generic GDN identity.

Retain conservative split_mixed_non_spec keyword and paired native schema. Replay after the padding-trim fix. Preserve current SYCL/Triton selection, V2 adaptive metadata and upstream transfer layout handling. No upstream equivalent was identified for either behavior.
dependencies: f057cf93b0a2f797d6b23164359fda2f0624f8d5 trims graph padding at the same native call; maintain both in dependency order.
d8e1f69699496beeda61da9a544f49d9b6378d73 supplies native split_mixed_non_spec; both halves must agree on the argument and default. Kernel release bump alone does not provide it.

066206bafebe124485a69e13dcb975a2afc55ad2 changes scheduler allocation and tests later, but leaves the assigned adapter, Qwen model and transfer implementation unchanged. Its KVarN changes are independently owned.

observed: Verified assigned stable patch ID, inspected assigned patch and later touched paths, read frozen v0.34 Python and v0.1.17 C++ dispatch/schema and scheduler code, compared upstream adapter blobs, and searched target for both missing backend symbols and the native keyword.
Recorded v0.33 validation includes 738 scheduler/cache/prefix/GDN metadata cases and two XPU-only Qwen identity cases (../../rebase-v033-20261108/validation.json). This is historical coverage.
proposed: Run committed tests/v1/core/test_mamba_align_chunk_split.py, scheduler/prefix suites, test_ssu_dispatch.py, connector HMA/conv decomposition tests on both layouts, and test_qwen_gdn_uses_distinct_backend_only_on_xpu. Ragged non-final chunks align. Final tails survive. Budgets and thresholds that would starve a request fail closed. Rejected profiles keep existing behavior.

Run test_gdn_adapter_splits_only_ordinary_mixed_non_spec on the installed pair and kernel tests/gdn_attn/test_gdn_attn.py on B70 against isolated cached decode, checking output, continued recurrent/conv state, and correct handling of speculation and padding. Run a second actual text-only non-spec mode=none mixed workload along with normal Brutus V2/DFlash2 qualification.
validation.limitations: This source audit ran no new GPU, CPU unit or timing trials. Exact mixed-batch whole-model tokens and performance on the new binary remain unverified.
